question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**the many agencies."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option is '**the many agencies.'**
 
• '**The**' is used before a noun to show that the reader is aware of the noun's identification.
 
 
• **Example**:* I must return **the** books now.*
 
 
 
• **The correct sentence is**: *as only one of **the many agencies** in the community.*
